title.zh: 【Akash 团队计划离开 Cosmos，并选定 Solana 作为迁移目标】
title.en: 【Akash 团队计划离开 Cosmos，并选定 Solana 作为迁移目标】

current_state.zh:
Akash Network 联合创始人 Greg Osuri 表示，核心团队已选定 Solana 作为迁移目标，计划让 Akash Network 离开其 Cosmos 主权链 akashnet-2，将算力市场重建为 Solana 主网上的原生程序，AKT 则成为 Solana 原生 SPL 代币。该计划尚未最终确定：团队须先在 akashnet-2 上通过治理提案（需达 33.4% 法定人数且多数赞成），并在两家独立审计完成后，AKT 才会在 Solana 上发行。

Akash 是成熟的 DePIN 算力网络，弃用自有主权链意味着取消目前用于保障网络安全的 AKT 质押与验证者结构，并将代币置于 Solana 的流动性与用户基础之中——Helium、Render、io.net 等同类 DePIN 项目已在 Solana 上运行。团队评估中的另一入围选项为以太坊 L2。

按计划，为期两年的单向迁移门户将在提案通过且审计完成后开放，AKT 按 1:1 迁移为 SPL 代币，代码、小数位与总供应量均不变。算力市场的切换时间尚未确定，需在审计和迁移演练完成后由单独的治理投票决定；切换后现有工作负载将继续运行 90 天，随后旧链停止运行，质押奖励于切换时结束，验证者角色及收入于旧链停止时结束。
current_state.en: Akash Network's core team has selected Solana as the target for migrating off its Cosmos sovereign chain, planning to rebuild its compute marketplace as native Solana programs and issue AKT as an SPL token pending governance approval, audits, and a two-year 1:1 migration portal.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Akash Network's core team has selected Solana as the target for migrating off its Cosmos sovereign chain, planning to rebuild its compute marketplace as native Solana programs and issue AKT as an SPL token pending governance approval, audits, and a two-year 1:1 migration portal.
updates.background_zh: Akash Network 在一条 Cosmos SDK 链上运营去中心化云算力市场，该链采用 CometBFT 共识并接入 IBC 生态，AKT 用于治理与质押。2025 年 10 月，Greg Osuri 曾表示 Akash 将弃用自有链，迁移至能保障其安全的链，候选链可能位于 Cosmos 内部或外部，但均兼容 IBC。
updates.background_en: Akash Network runs a decentralized cloud compute marketplace on a Cosmos SDK chain secured by CometBFT consensus and connected to the IBC ecosystem, with AKT used for governance and staking. In October 2025 Osuri said Akash intended to abandon its own chain and migrate to a chain that could guarantee its security, with candidate chains possibly inside or outside Cosmos but all IBC-compatible.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该决定使 AKT 持有者面对一个单向的 1:1 转换门户，代币流动性与托管场所将从 Cosmos 相关场所转向 Solana；而 akashnet-2 的最终关停将终结旧链上的质押需求与验证者收入。时间表取决于治理投票与审计，目前旧链仍在运行。
updates.market_impact_en: The decision puts AKT holders in front of a one-way 1:1 conversion portal into an SPL token, shifting where AKT liquidity and custody sit from Cosmos venues toward Solana, while the eventual shutdown of akashnet-2 would end staking demand and validator revenue on the old chain. Timing depends on governance votes and audits, so the current chain remains in operation for now.
